title: Chapter 280: Chapter 20 The 'Coordinates' Of The Spirit Realm, It’S Not Impossible (Returning Tomorrow, Please Subscribe) _2

Chapter 280: Chapter 20 The 'Coordinates' Of The Spirit Realm, It’S Not Impossible (Returning Tomorrow, Please Subscribe) _2

Chapter 280: Chapter 20 The ‘Coordinates’ of the Spirit Realm, It’s Not Impossible (Returning Tomorrow, Please Subscribe) _2

Mu Qingliu looked at Lin Yuan and said softly,

“Open.”

Lin Yuan nodded.

This indeed matched the location of the rift in space he had sensed.

Mu Qingliu was quite tactful, not scheming on this matter.

“Very well.”

...

What Mu Qingliu did not know was,

if he had harbored any other intentions, Lin Yuan would have seen right through him.

At Lin Yuan’s current realm, space was like paper before him; he could clearly feel every fluctuation.

Whoosh.

Under Mu Qingliu’s manipulation,

the entrance to the secret realm was gradually being opened.

The space inside revealed itself.

At the deepest part of the space,

a portal only half a meter tall, made of stone, came into view.

“Is that the Ascension Platform?”

Lin Yuan’s gaze shifted there.

This stone portal faintly had spatial fluctuations swirling around it, and the portal itself displayed a silvery-white color.

The instant Lin Yuan gazed at this portal,

a majestic and grand Door to the Myriad Realms in the depths of his mind suddenly began to glow.

Seemingly invisible fluctuations swept over the distant Ascension Platform.

A moment later,

a stream of information from the Door to the Myriad Realms was transmitted to Lin Yuan’s mind.

“Oh?”

Lin Yuan was slightly startled.

He glanced at Mu Qingliu next to him.

He noticed that Mu Qingliu had not perceived any of the recent changes.

It was as if the power sweeping out from the Door to the Myriad Realms existed in another dimension, unnoticed by anyone.

“Coordinates of the ‘Spirit Realm’….”

Lin Yuan rubbed his brow, the information transmitted from the Door to the Myriad Realms was indeed the coordinates of the ‘Spirit Realm.’

At this very moment,

Lin Yuan partially immersed his consciousness into his mind.

He gazed at that majestic and grand Door to the Myriad Realms.

If one were to observe, they would find that near the threshold of the Door to the Myriad Realms,

there existed five seals.

These five seals represented the coordinates of the Martial World, Dragon Tiger World, Divine Arms World, Five Regions World, and the current Immortal Tao World.

These five worlds, all of which Lin Yuan had once traversed, were thus locked onto by the Door to the Myriad Realms, capturing their coordinates.

Because of this, armed with the world coordinates, Lin Yuan could spend ten strands of ‘World-Breaking Origin Force’ to revisit these worlds.

But now,

following those five world coordinate seals,

a sixth world coordinate seal formed anew.

It was the ‘Spirit Realm’s’ world coordinates.

Although Lin Yuan had not descended into the Spirit Realm,

the Ascension Platform was connected to the Spirit Realm, and it naturally contained the Spirit Realm’s coordinates inside.

The force from the Door to the Myriad Realms had just swept the Ascension Platform, copying its internal world coordinates.

“Spirit Realm…”

Lin Yuan’s expression was slightly odd.

Theoretically, with the Spirit Realm’s coordinates,

Lin Yuan could return to the Main World and spend ten strands of ‘World-Breaking Origin Force’ to descend to the Spirit Realm once more.

…

Seeing Lin Yuan intently looking at the Ascension Platform, Mu Qingliu did not dare to urge him, and could only continue to wait.

“Let your Immortal Sect Ancestors come down.”

Lin Yuan waited patiently for a while, confirming that there were no other world coordinates inside the Ascension Platform, then he spoke.

“Ah?”

At these words, Mu Qingliu was slightly shaken.

He didn’t expect Lin Yuan to be so forthright, giving him time to summon the Ancestral Masters of the Spirit Realm.

“Very well.”

Mu Qingliu hesitated for a moment, then agreed.

After all, this was what Lin Yuan had asked him to do; whatever happened later had nothing to do with him.

Mu Qingliu entered the secret realm and approached the Ascension Platform, his demeanor respectful, employing a secret technique, his lips barely moving as if uttering some words.

A moment later,

the Ascension Platform began to glow.

Spatial fluctuations started to intensify, as if a terrifying power was piercing through two worlds, descending along a fixed spatial passage.

In front of the Ascension Platform,

the figure of a Taoist wearing a Daoist robe slowly materialized.

“I am Cangqing Immortal. Are you the one who wishes to see me?”

The Taoist’s figure was ethereal as he looked at Lin Yuan with a smile on his lips.

“A strand of projection from a Unity Realm True Immortal?”

Lin Yuan was similarly observing the other party.

The Spirit Realm and the Central Divine Continent were separated by two realms. Even the most powerful beings from the upper realm could not descend to the lower realms in their true form, at most they could send down a projection.

This projection could not stray too far from the Ascension Platform; otherwise, it might lose connection with its main body in the upper realm and directly collapse.

“Hmm?”

Cangqing Immortal looked at Lin Yuan, the more he observed, the more shocked he felt inside.

Mu Qingliu had already informed him about the numerous pieces of intelligence regarding Lin Yuan.

Such as cultivating for hundreds of years, surpassing the peak of Refine Void, and simultaneously creating another cultivation system not inferior to the Immortal Path, and so on.

Cangqing Immortal had also relayed this intelligence to the other Ancestors of the Daode Immortal Sect.

All the Ancestors unanimously believed that Lin Yuan must have been seized by some powerful being from tens of thousands of years ago.

Otherwise,

in the Central Divine Continent, progressing to this extent alone without the support of the Daode Immortal Sect was nearly impossible.

Especially the Martial Tao cultivation system, with such a conception and potential not inferior to the Immortal Path cultivation system, how could it be created in just a few hundred years?

It must be those powerful beings who reincarnated, those who lived through the long ages, experienced many eras, obtained this Martial Tao cultivation system, and are now beginning to spread it, thus stirring up a series of movements within the Central Divine Continent…

This was the ‘truth’ conjectured by the Ancestral Masters of the Immortal Sects from the Spirit Realm.

The reason Cangqing Immortal descended his projection to the lower realm this time was that among the ancestors of the Daode Immortal Sect through the ages, Cangqing Immortal had lived the longest and knew the most old monsters, perhaps he could identify which powerful being had taken over Lin Yuan.

As long as they understood Lin Yuan’s origins, everything would be easy to handle.

However, now,

Cangqing Immortal was somewhat dazed.

Because from his observations,

Lin Yuan’s soul and body were in perfect harmony.

He didn’t seem to have been seized at all. It’s known that even if a True Immortal of the Merged Path performed a seizure, there would be a slight rejection due to the different origins of the soul and body.

Based on this kind of rejection, it was very easy to identify the seizer’s identity.

But now,

there was absolutely no such sense of rejection in Lin Yuan.

There were two possibilities.

One was that the projection he had descended was too weak, so much so that it could not detect that kind of rejection from the seizure.

The second was that Lin Yuan had not been seized.

Cangqing Immortal felt that the first possibility was not likely.

The projection he had descended, even if weak, was still that of a Unity Realm True Immortal.

With his insight, he naturally could see that Lin Yuan had not stepped into the Unity Realm.

With such a difference in realms, Cangqing Immortal did not believe he could miss the sense of rejection from a seizure.

Since the first possibility was ruled out,

that left the second possibility.

Lin Yuan reaching today’s status, growing in a few hundred years to be the strongest in this realm, and even pioneering a cultivation system not inferior to the Immortal Path…

was all by himself.

“Who would have thought that such a monstrous talent would emerge from the barren lower realms,”

Cangqing Immortal quietly watched Lin Yuan, “Even in the Spirit Realm, such aptitude would only be found in the core disciples of the Immortal King-level Forces, and even pioneering a unique cultivation system distinct from the Way of Immortals, this potential… ”

Cangqing Immortal’s thoughts were churning.

Without a doubt,

Lin Yuan’s potential was absolutely the most monstrous he had witnessed, even surpassing those Immortal princes or even some Immortal Kings during their youth.

After all, Lin Yuan had reached such achievements in the lower realms, while those Immortal princes and young Immortal Kings grew up in the vast Spirit Realm; the two simply couldn’t compare.

“So you wish to spread the Martial Tao cultivation system in the Central Divine Continent…”

Cangqing Immortal looked at Lin Yuan and slowly said.

Next to him, Mu Qingliu’s mind tensed upon hearing his ancestor utter these words.

He vividly remembered,

When he first relayed the intelligence and intentions about Lin Yuan to the ancestors,

The enormity of the ancestors’ reaction.

“Such audacity.”

“Dreaming of spreading other cultivation systems in my Central Divine Continent.”

“The Central Divine Continent, bathed in the radiance of the Immortal Path, can only dignify the Immortal Path alone. Other cultivation systems might struggle to survive, but going against the mainstream is utterly impossible.”

…

The above encapsulated the attitudes of the ancestors.

This time, the reason for Cangqing Immortal’s descent of power to the lower realm was not only because he had lived the longest, and was most likely to recognize Lin Yuan’s background,

but also because Cangqing Immortal was the strongest.

Even if just a projection, he could still exert combat power close to that of the Dao Integration Realm.

“Are we going to fight?”

“I wonder if Wuji can match the ancestor.”

Mu Qingliu subconsciously took a few steps back, as if already foreseeing the tense situation that was about to unfold.

But the next words from Cangqing Immortal,

left Mu Qingliu stunned in his place.

“It’s not necessarily impossible…”

Cangqing Immortal pondered for a while, and seriously said.
